current_profile_snapshot.groove_behavior: restrained swing or straight feel with more space and lighter attack than hard-driving swing
current_profile_snapshot.phrase_behavior: longer understated phrases, counterlines and deliberate rests
current_profile_snapshot.harmony_behavior: extended/modal harmony with transparent voicings and slower harmonic rhythm as options
current_profile_snapshot.bass_behavior: walking or sparse melodic bass; less aggressive attack
current_profile_snapshot.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: brushes/light kit favored; percussion leaves air
current_profile_snapshot.instrument_role_behavior: horn/woodwind lead, piano/guitar, bass, light drums; chamber colors allowed
current_profile_snapshot.ensemble_player_behavior: balanced, conversational ensemble; no section overwhelms texture
current_profile_snapshot.arrangement_transformation: ABA/through-composed or head/solo forms with textural restraint
current_profile_snapshot.articulation_behavior: soft attacks, legato lines, understated accents
current_profile_snapshot.sound_effects_intent: natural ambience; subtle plate/room if target uses effects
current_profile_snapshot.mix_prominence_intent: transparent mix with bass and melody both clear
current_profile_snapshot.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: favor nuanced dynamic voices over bright generic substitutions
